## README.md
# California Geological Survey Datasets

Cloud-optimized publication of California Geological Survey (CGS) Geologic Data Map (GDM) series products, hosted on the NRP Nautilus S3 bucket `public-cgs`.

Public URL: <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/>

## Available collections

- **[Sierra Nevada Earth Science Atlas (GDM 009)](sierra-nevada-atlas/stac-collection.json)** — collaborative CGS/USGS geologic mapping of California's Sierra Nevada. Currently includes the geologic unit polygon layer; remaining layers (faults, landslides, neotectonics, geophysical anomalies, geochronology, mineralization) tracked in [data-workflows#149](https://github.com/boettiger-lab/data-workflows/issues/149).

## Sierra Nevada Earth Science Atlas — Map Unit Polygons

Geologic-unit polygons for the Sierra Nevada region. 6,221 features across 268 distinct map units, derived from the `MapUnitPolys` feature class of the source File Geodatabase. Reprojected from NAD83 / California Albers (EPSG:3310) to WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

### Assets

| Asset | URL |
|---|---|
| GeoParquet | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/map-unit-polys.parquet> |
| PMTiles | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/map-unit-polys.pmtiles> |
| H3 hex (res 10) | `https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/map-unit-polys/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet` |
| Map-unit descriptions | <https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/description-of-map-units.parquet> |

### DuckDB example

```sql
INSTALL spatial; LOAD spatial;
INSTALL httpfs; LOAD httpfs;

-- Geologic units with full names, ages, and standardized rock classes
SELECT
  p.MapUnit,
  d.Name,
  d.Age,
  d.GeoMaterial,
  COUNT(*)         AS n_polygons,
  SUM(p.Shape_Area) AS area_m2
FROM read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/map-unit-polys.parquet') p
LEFT JOIN read_parquet('https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/description-of-map-units.parquet') d
  USING (MapUnit)
GROUP BY p.MapUnit, d.Name, d.Age, d.GeoMaterial
ORDER BY area_m2 DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

### MapLibre GL JS example

PMTiles `source-layer` is **`map-unit-polys`** (last segment of `--dataset`).

```js
map.addSource('snesa-units', {
  type: 'vector',
  url: 'pmtiles://https://s3-west.nrp-nautilus.io/public-cgs/sierra-nevada-atlas/map-unit-polys.pmtiles'
});
map.addLayer({
  id: 'snesa-units-fill',
  source: 'snesa-units',
  'source-layer': 'map-unit-polys',
  type: 'fill',
  paint: {
    'fill-color': ['match', ['get', 'MapUnit'],
      'water', '#3b82f6',
      'gl', '#cbd5e1',
      'aft', '#a16207',
      /* default */ '#9ca3af'
    ],
    'fill-opacity': 0.7,
    'fill-outline-color': '#1f2937'
  }
});
```

## Source

- **Producer:** California Geological Survey + U.S. Geological Survey
- **Original release:** GDM_009-SNESA-Data.zip, 2026 (v1 data; companion report expected late 2026)
